intro: We are building an interdisciplinary team of scientists committed to translational immunology. We welcome applicants who are curious, collaborative, and motivated to bridge mechanistic biology with clinical impact.
who_we_are_looking_for: PhD students interested in immunology, genomics, and quantitative analysis
Postdoctoral fellows with strong publication records and translational ambition
Research staff with experience in cell engineering, flow cytometry, or NGS workflows
how_to_apply: Email a CV, a brief statement of research interests, and contact details for 2-3 references.
If applicable, include one representative manuscript or preprint.
In your message, note which research theme aligns most closely with your goals.
culture: Our lab culture emphasizes shared standards, generous collaboration, and deliberate professional development. We invest in mentorship, reproducibility, and inclusive scientific dialogue.

open_positions.title: Postdoctoral Fellow - Autoimmune Antigen Discovery
open_positions.details: Focus on integrating cohort immunology and antigen mapping across pediatric and adult arthritis studies. Experience with repertoire analysis or proteomics preferred.

open_positions.title: Research Associate - Functional Genomics
open_positions.details: Lead pooled CRISPR screening experiments and validation workflows in primary immune systems. Prior experience with NGS library prep is desirable.
